data.titulo: Job Questions the Help Bildad Has Given

data.text: “How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the arm without strength!
What counsel you have given the one without wisdom! What an abundance of sound wisdom you have made known!
To whom have you spoken these words? Whose breath has come out of you?
The shades of the dead tremble beneath the waters and their inhabitants.
data.titulo: God’s Power from the Depths to the Heavens

data.text: Sheol is naked before him, and Abaddon has no covering.
He stretches out the north over the void and hangs the earth upon nothing.
He binds up the waters in his clouds, and the cloud does not split beneath them.
He covers the face of his throne, spreading his cloud over it.
He has drawn a circular boundary on the surface of the waters, at the limit of light and darkness.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astounded at his rebuke.
By his power he stirs the sea, and by his understanding he crushes Rahab.
By his breath the heavens are cleared; his hand pierces the fleeing serpent.
Look, these are only the edges of his ways; what a faint whisper we hear of him! But the thunder of his mighty deeds—who can understand it?”
data.titulo: Only the Edges of God’s Ways
